personal_info.summary: Frontend Developer with 4+ years of experience improving performance and scalability in modern web applications. Specialized in React, Vue, and TypeScript, with proven results like reducing load times by up to 90% and streamlining complex UI workflows. Skilled in building reusable component systems, optimizing data-heavy interfaces, and aligning technical solutions with business needs.

responsibilities: Led the modernization of 15+ web projects by migrating to DDEV and Vite, reducing asset compilation times and enabling version consistency for PHP and MySQL environments.
Improved site performance by up to 90% through CSS refactoring and dynamic asset optimization, based on audits using Lighthouse and GTmetrix.
Redesigned 8+ complex search tools for a legal research platform with 1,435+ global cases using VueJS and Reactjs, enhancing data interactivity and UI responsiveness.
Built scalable, dynamic UI modules with advanced filtering, lazy loading, and pagination for large datasets.
Implemented CI pipelines (GitHub Actions) and dependency automation (Dependabot + custom scripts), improving code quality and reducing technical debt.
Collaborated with company leadership to align technical priorities with business goals; led weekly frontend syncs and managed full SDLC using Agile methodologies.
